title: Mario Kart World's Knockout Tour Just Got More Intriguing With New Update
description: Nintendo has introduced team battles for Mario Kart World's Knockout Tour with a free new update. The mode previously only allowed for solo competition, but now offers three different options for cooperative contests: two teams of 12, three teams of eight, or four teams of six. It's available in local or online multiplayer. Knockout Tour made its debut with Mario Kart World, as it's a new mode not previously seen in the long-running franchise. The race sees players battling 23 other characters over a long stretch, with checkpoints taking out four contestants at a time. It feels like being in the middle of a chase from Mad Max: Fury Road at points. With Knockout Tour's team battles, each person on the team gets a point based on their finish. First-place winners will receive 50 points, while anyone who can't get past the initial checkpoint will only get one point. Obviously, the total score added up from the entire team decides final placement. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Men Aged 18-34 Love Fallout Season 2, Prime Video Says
description: Prime Video has shared new data that speaks to the success of Fallout Season 2. The company said Season 2 is Prime Video's best-performing new season since Reacher Season 3 in February 2025. Additionally, Fallout Season is now Prime Video's No. 6 most popular season ever. It's behind The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Seasons 1 and 2, along with Reacher Seasons 2 and 3, and Fallout Season 1. Amazon also noted that 53% of viewership for Fallout Season 2 came from international markets, with the show performing especially well in the UK, Germany, and Brazil. It's also a hit with men aged 18-34, becoming one of Prime Video's top five most-watched series in that demographic. Prime Video did not, however, share any specific viewership numbers. Sources told Deadline, which supplied all these data points, that Prime Video may wait until the end of Season 2 to share specific viewership data, or it might not at all. title: Sonic The Hedgehog Is Getting Scripted Noir Podcast Starring The Chaotix
description: This year marks the 35th anniversary of Sonic the Hedgehog, but Sega's first Sonic project of 2026 isn't what anyone expected. Instead of revealing a new Sonic game, the official Sonic the Hedgehog YouTube page has shared a teaser trailer for a new noir-ish scripted podcast called Sonic Presents: The Chaotix Casefiles. While Sonic will have a leading role in the story, it appears that the Chaotix--Vector the Crocodile, Espio the Chameleon, and Charmy Bee--are taking the primary focus as "the intrepid Chaotix Detective Agency." That trio of heroes made their debut in Knuckles' Chaotix before returning in Sonic Heroes and forming their own detective agency. The description for the series doesn't offer many hints about the story itself, although Eggman is also confirmed to appear. According to the video, the Chaotix and Sonic will embark on a "high-flying, action-packed adventure [that] will take them across the world, fighting for every clue they can find. It's one heck of a tale. Which is good, because this story might be the only thing that can save their lives." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Game Union Calls For Strike Against Ubisoft Following Cancellations
description: Earlier in January, Ubisoft shut down Ubisoft Halifax and laid off 70 developers who had recently voted to unionize. But those aren't the only cuts ahead, as recently disclosed by Ubisoft. Six games have already been canceled--including the Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time remake--and Ubisoft CEO Yves Guillemot indicated that more layoffs will be coming. In response, the French video game union Solidaires Informatique has called for a half-day strike. In the social media post below, Solidaires Informatique set its strike date for January 22, and issued the following demands to Ubisoft's management. An end to the cost-reduction plan Maintenance and expansion of remote work conditions Decent pay raises for the coming year UBISOFT - Call for strike Following the disastrous announcements made by Mr. Yves Guillemot (cost-cutting plan, projects scrapped, end of remote working, etc.), the Solidaires Informatique union is calling for a strike on Thursday, January 22, in the morning.[image or embed] — Solidaires Informatique (@solinfonat.bsky.social) January 21, 2026 at 11:32 AM The union characterized its actions as a response to "the absurdity of management decisions," and didn't rule out further actions against Ubisoft. title: Black Ops 7 Had Call Of Duty's Worst Sales Year Ranking In The US Since 2008
description: In the last two decades, there have only been a handful of years that the Call of Duty franchise didn't finish as the No. 1 best-selling video game in the US. Following the blockbuster performance of Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 in 2024 wasn't going to be an easy feat for any game. But according to the domestic sales charts, Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 not only failed to repeat its predecessor's success, but fell to No. 5 in the US for 2025. Circana has shared its US video game sales charts for December 2025 and the entire calendar year. According to that report, Black Ops 7 was the No. 1 best-selling game across all physical and digital platforms in December. That continued Call of Duty's seven-year streak of dominating the sales chart in December. The last time it was dethroned from its perch atop the final month of the year was when Super Smash Bros. Ultimate took No. 1 in December 2018. For 2025, Battlefield 6 was the top-selling game in the US across all platforms. Black Ops 7's performance in December raised it from 2025's No. 7 best-selling game in the US--as of November 2025--to a fifth-place finish for the year. Regardless, that is still the worst end-of-year ranking for a Call of Duty game in the US since Call of Duty: World at War finished at No. 7 in 2008. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Switch 2 Reached New Sales Heights In The US In 2025
description: Heading into 2025, it was widely expected that Nintendo Switch 2 would break sales records. Now that Circana has released its report on the US video game market in 2025, we have a better picture of just how well Switch 2 performed and how far ahead it is of its predecessor. According to Circana, Switch 2 led the domestic video game hardware market in both unit and dollar sales with 4.4 million consoles in its first seven months of release. That's 94% higher than the original Switch's sales numbers at the same point in its lifespan. When compared to Sony's PlayStation 4, Switch 2 is 35% ahead of PS4's sales in the same time period. A previous analysis by The Game Business noted that Switch 2's domestic sales plummeted 35% from November to December. Circana had also previously reported that November 2025 was the worst month for video game hardware sales in the US since 1995. That same month, Nintendo apologized for Switch 2 shortages that persisted for months. Continue Reading at GameSpot
